purpose: Concepts for user selection only; not game assets or Blender renders

prompts.ring:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Create an original premium fantasy tactical-game UI DESIGN STUDY, not an in-game screenshot. Portrait concept sheet, approximately 1536x2048, dark charcoal presentation background, restrained warm bronze and carved cool grey stone with delicate arcane cyan light. Title "R — ARCANE ASSEMBLY". Inspiration: tactile handcrafted fantasy collectible-card-game interface and a mage's spell preparation ritual; avoid any game logo.
Main large overhead view occupying upper 65%: a hero silhouette at the center of an intricate MULTI-PART MAGIC RING. Exactly FIVE stationary circular skill buttons at the pentagon vertices, top then around the circle. Their thin identity rims are GOLD at top, SILVER upper-right, RED lower-right, GREEN lower-left, BLUE upper-left. Buttons are clearly stationary, upright and arranged like the UI controls above moving machinery; label centers simply "1","2","3","4","5". Do not put any other clickable discs in this composition.
Behind these stationary buttons show distinct mechanical layers: fixed five mounting tabs; one interrupted ancient bronze segmented outer rotating rotor; one finer counter-rotating inner rune band; three small NON-INTERACTIVE gyroscope hoops physically sleeved around short sections of the rotating outer ring, with their own tilted local spin axes. These small nested hoops are narrow open torus shapes, NOT extra buttons or solid jewels. Fine glyph engravings, chamfered edges, blackened crevices, slight blue rune light. Motion arrows only on the rotors and three gyroscopes; NEVER on buttons. Keep the center around the hero airy, no giant glow covering battlefield. Make stationary anchors and moving rings visually distinct and structurally plausible; rotations do not drag the five skill buttons.
Lower portion: three small simplified time frames labeled "0s", "2s", "4s", showing buttons fixed in EXACT same positions/orientations while the broken ring segments and little gimbal hoops rotate. Under them a compact exploded side view separating fixed button plane above two moving rotor planes. Fine callout labels "FIXED SKILLS", "OUTER ROTOR", "INNER ROTOR", "NESTED HOOPS". State "CONCEPT — NOT IMPLEMENTED".
Beautiful readable hand-painted 3D material render with technical sketch arrows; clean generous spacing; use crisp minimal English annotation only. This is one proposal for a layered rotating ornament, not a whole game redesign.
prompts.badges:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Draw a premium fantasy-game UI badge OPTIONS comparison sheet as a polished 3D material sketch, portrait approximately 1536x2048. Dark muted slate background, consistent upper-left studio light, realistic worn stone bevels and aged bronze; all three columns use the same lighting and scale. Title "STAT BADGES — A / B / C". Crisp grid with THREE COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS. Columns labeled "A — DEEP CARVE", "B — SYMBOL SHAPE", "C — METAL INLAY". Row labels small on the left: "MOVE", "DEFEND", "PRIMARY", "RANGE", "INITIATIVE". Leave enough space for five full rows, do not omit rows. Exact sample numbers down every column: 2, 6, 4, 3, 12.
A: cohesive irregular octagonal thick slate tiles. Small top semantic bas-relief symbol (boot, shield, sword, target diamond, hourglass). The LARGE numeral must be physically cut INTO the stone surface: broad V-cut walls, dark recesses, lit near edge and shadowed far edge, same stone material on cut walls. NOT printed, NOT a bright flat font on stone, NOT a hovering numeral.
B: Each entire tile silhouette is its meaning, still broad enough to hold its deeply carved ivory-stone numeral. MOVE is a compact wide boot/tread silhouette with the 2 in the ankle area; DEFEND is a wide rounded heraldic shield with the 6 in its center; PRIMARY is a short broad sword-pommel/crossguard-shaped badge with the 4 in the broad main center, tiny blade tip stays within footprint; RANGE is a faceted targeting diamond with notched corner marks and centered 3; INITIATIVE is an hourglass silhouette with wide joined-waist central inset accommodating 12 legibly. The OUTER SHAPE itself must differ across the five stats, not five identical slabs with small icons. Use a consistent thick stone/bronze socket language and balanced proportions; no needles or protrusions that would exceed a small skill disc.
C: restrained unified shallow stone sockets with forged pale-silver numerals inserted INTO matching carved grooves, almost flush with surface, a subtle raised bevel only, tight dark contact-shadow seam around each digit. Numerals are real solid material pieces, not text decals floating above the substrate. Tiny aged-bronze semantic symbol appears above, stable same place as A. 2/6/4/3/12 all legible; never gold/yellow numerals that would resemble a bonus state.
Bottom strip with a close-up cross-section comparison: A recessed cut, B sculpted outline + cut, C recessed pocket with tightly fitted metal insert. Small labels "CUT", "SHAPED STONE", "INSET METAL". Show stone grain broken at the cuts and fine edge wear. Avoid excessive cracks through digits, marble noise, luminous white text, fake distant game backgrounds. Text "DESIGN STUDY — NOT IMPLEMENTED" at the bottom.
This sheet compares actual object geometry/material, not merely fonts; especially numerals must visibly participate in depth and light.
prompts.integration:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Original premium fantasy tactical game interface detail design sheet, portrait approximately 1536x2048 on charcoal background. Title "SKILL DISC — INTEGRATION". Three large circular skill buttons, one per horizontal row down the page, labeled A, B, C to the left, with little closeups to their right. Identical button size and identical corner positions in all three variants so the user can compare. Each disc has a heavy aged-brass chamfered rim, restrained red color channel, dark stone center with a subtle engraved sword placeholder illustration, no long skill text. ALL FIVE STAT BADGES hug INSIDE/ON its rim: upper-left movement 2, upper-right defense 6, lower-left attack 4, lower-right range 3, centered at the bottom initiative 12. Each badge should be about one quarter the disc diameter and stay within the disc square footprint. Bottom initiative panel slightly wider for two digits; do not overlap lower-left and lower-right. The hero/ring/battlefield are not part of this sheet.
Variant A: uniform broad stone badges, small sculpted boot/shield/sword/target/hourglass icons, physically deep incised numeral grooves with shadows. Variant B: all FIVE external badge shapes express meaning: boot, rounded shield, short broad sword-pommel, targeting diamond, hourglass; broad centers make numbers readable. Variant C: pale forged-metal numeral pieces fitted into carved stone pockets, nearly flush with an inset contact shadow; not floating white text. Maintain two-tone physical stone/metal appearance and readable numerals. Design attractive dense handcrafted forms inspired by premium fantasy card game craft, never thin flat stroke icons.
To the right of each disc, two large material macro details show the corresponding shield badge and the speed badge with true thickness, bevels and cut/insert surfaces. At bottom show a small row of state examples using variant B outline with inset numeral treatment: ordinary pale ivory "6", green-tinted material "8", red-tinted material "4", wide speed "-2", defense infinity "∞". Labels "BASE", "BUFF", "DEBUFF", "NEGATIVE", "INFINITY". Color changes apply to the numeral's material within its recess; dark cut edges remain. Be meticulous about the numeral readability, especially 12, -2 and infinity. No floating bonus plus text outside the disc, no numerals drawn like a plain digital overlay. Include "CONCEPT — NOT IMPLEMENTED".
prompts.ringR2:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Draw a premium fantasy tactical-game concept sheet for a LIGHT ARCANE ROTATING SKILL RING. Portrait approximately 1536x2048. Title "R2 — LIGHT ARCANE RING". An elegant spell-preparation ring around a hero, crafted bronze-and-rune magic, markedly lighter than a heavy clockwork or stone floor device. Dark neutral softly blurred plain battlefield backdrop, not a constructed solid stone circle, no new terrain.
Large top view: exactly FIVE stationary skill discs on pentagon corners, top gold, upper-right silver, lower-right red, lower-left green, upper-left blue; label 1 2 3 4 5 upright. Behind these fixed buttons, much thinner broken bronze arcs orbit clockwise; a fine translucent rune-only circular band rotates slowly counterclockwise. At THREE points on the rotating broken bronze track, slender small magic torus cuffs wrap around the track like hoops sleeved onto a rail, each hoop turning about its own different local axis. These nested hoops are airy wire-thin bronze and light, not solid spherical ornaments, no jewels. Only these decorative layers move. Blue-gold glowing edges restrained; approximately 70 percent of the area inside the pentagon is visually unobstructed, hero and underlying ground clear. Five skill discs are prominent readable controls; rings are quiet decoration. Materials tactile hand-crafted bronze bevels, fine stone surfaces; mage spell ritual energy, thin magical dust, not futuristic neon HUD or steampunk gears.
Use blue arrows to indicate clockwise outer fragments, counterclockwise inner glyph band, and local rotation of the little sleeved hoops. No arrows on stationary buttons. Simple callout labels "FIXED BUTTONS", "ROTATING ARCS", "COUNTER ROTATING RUNES", "LOCAL SPIN".
Lower third: three smaller frames "IDLE", "HOVER", "SELECT". Same stationary buttons in exactly same position/orientation. IDLE uses gentle minimal rune glow; HOVER subtly lights only the nearby arc without moving or enlarging the button positions; SELECT adds a brief localized pulse, does not move buttons around ring. Not an actual video or already implemented UI.
Bottom right detailed small cutaway of one thin ring segment with an intersecting torus cuff that spins around the segment, an empty hole clearly visible and a pivot axis sketch. Minimal short labels only, no invented prose. Bottom footer "CONCEPT — NOT IMPLEMENTED". High-quality polished original UI design sketch with exquisite material readability and uncluttered negative space.

The bottom NEGATIVE example must be an HOURGLASS-shaped badge containing "-2", not a boot. Keep all other bottom state samples unchanged.

Dark cavity floors, rough same-stone cut walls with lit chamfers, visually unmistakably carved inward. Keep readability. A's icons may remain relief bronze. C stays near-flush pale metal inset, with narrow contact-shadow groove. B stays semantic silhouette and near-flush metal inset: change its sublabel to "SHAPED BADGES + INLAY" to make clear it combines B shapes with C numeral material.
